notes.title: Update 4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257783/649faf518e3298d1ca8298d0891b97fa9a120f05.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Community,[/p][p][/p][p]We are happy to announce that [b]MindsEye's Update 4 is now released across all platforms; PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.[/b][/p][p]Update 4 introduces a range of UX improvements, numerous performance enhancements to the game and we’ve squashed a load of bugs. These efforts will continue in Update 5, where our team is working hard to deliver a major performance, combat and Enemy AI system improvement.[/p][p]Many thanks for your continued support, we appreciate your passionate feedback - it truly helps us prioritize the updates that the community cares about most.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Highlights[/u][/p][olist][*][p]UI: Added the ability to Skip Cinematics story telling[/p][/*][*][p]Environment: several improvements have been made to architecture and assets to help improve Memory, CPU and GPU performance[/p][/*][*][p]Art: general performance improvements: shaders, assets, collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay: Aim assist will focus on enemies in vehicle turrets over the driver[/p][/*][*][p]Build.MindsEye (PC Only):[/p][olist][*][p]Added a new “Player Content” Tile to the MindsEye Play Menu where all Builders published content will be immediately available to browse and play[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UGC Moderation flow from Pre-Moderation to Post-Moderation[/p][/*][*][p]Player created content will now be automatically accessible in the new “Player Content” Tile[/p][/*][*][p]A new Tile for “Curated Content” has been added, that will highlight player created content featured by our Studio[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]RELEASE SCHEDULE & PLATFORM INFO:[/b]   [/p][p]Time: September 5th, 2025 - 10:00 BST / 11:00 CEST / 02:00 PDT   [/p][p]Platforms: PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S   [/p][p]   [/p][p][b]Download size and version information:[/b]   [/p][p]Steam: 15 GB (Version #: 5302548)   [/p][p]Epic Games Store: 15 GB (Version #: 5302548)   [/p][p]Build A Rocket Boy Launcher: 15 GB (Version #: 5302548)   [/p][p]PlayStation 5: 7.2 GB (Version #: 01.010.00)   [/p][p]Xbox Series X|S: 12.1 GB (Version #: 1.0.25.5859)  [/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]MINDSEYE PATCH NOTES[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][p][b]Environment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trailer Tanks in Free Roam now explode when shot at[/p][/*][*][p]Several improvements have been made to architecture and assets to help with performance[/p][/*][*][p]Improved weather change when player leaves the Factory at the start of Robin Hood Mission[/p][/*][*][p]Improved traversal on A New Job and Loose Ends missions where player may get stuck in certain assets[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Visual Effects[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cutscene VFX performance improvements [/p][/*][*][p]Cutscene VFX management changes and Niagara system updates to reduce CPU spikes and overall frame rate [/p][/*][*][p]Disabled ambient rubbish to improve performance [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]NPC[/b][/p][list][*][p]Small performance improvement on Robots[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs that are aiming and in-cover now look more natural [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Art[/b][/p][list][*][p]General performance improvements: shaders, assets, collisions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI [/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved inconsistent dropdown menu behaviour in graphics settings, ensuring reliable input response [/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to skip cinematics[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Audio [/b][/p][list][*][p]Audio Optimisation regarding Mass Vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Music adjustments throughout MindsEye missions[/p][/*][*][p]Added Destruction SFX on Glass Bottle Props[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Missions [/b][/p][list][*][p]Conditional dialogue now triggers with more natural pacing[/p][/*][*][p]The companion drone torch is now automatically enabled when entering or starting in dark areas[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Animation [/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimised the ambient and civilian animations. [/p][/*][*][p]Exit/entry animations no longer play for driverless vehicles [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Gameplay [/b][/p][list][*][p]Aim assist will focus on enemies in vehicle turrets over the driver [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various Mission flow bug fixes [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pixelated reflection in Rocket Transporter window [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Industrial vent asset to help with performance [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where players transitioning from Meeting Marco Silva to Executive Paranoia could drive through objects and fall through the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ambient animation glitches in Welcome to Redrock City[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where camera rotation was lost after cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Several lighting LOD pop issues fixed in cutscenes  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where burning vehicles wouldn’t transition to destroyed state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several traversal issues in world where the player may get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in The Ziggurat where a hole in wall allowed players to climb through and trap themselves[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Oh Lily! where players could get stuck in Morrison's Silo without a way to get back out[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision on glass roof of Silva Factory[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of Character Model issues in cutscenes that made them look deformed and stretched for a few frames[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved Silva’s teeth looking too bright on medium/ lower settings on PC[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs no longer freeze when interacting with certain objects [/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Wheel hover SFX is now triggered correctly, without delays[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]PC only[/b][/p][list][*][p]The character Red Sand Male 25 is now available for use in Build.MindsEye[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI issue where backing out of a submenu in 'Build' caused the second-last selected tile to remain highlighted [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the ‘effects’ tile would remain highlighted after returning to Build mode from Play mode [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the placement header text overlapped UI elements in the asset settings menu when playing in French [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing specific Korean characters to appear invisible in vehicle spawner labels [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a localization issue where the French translation of “Total PI” overlapped with the performance impact number in the top toolbar [/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the incorrect icon used for the MindsEye menu button in Play/ Build with a proper menu icon [/p][/*][*][p]\[Min Spec Performance Improvement]: Disabled Nanite compute materials as it has a negative effect on GPU rendering time in our game, especially on older Nvidia Graphics Cards[/p][/*][*][p]\[Min Spec Performance Improvement]: Fixed an issue where our Nanite render pipeline always used the Hardware Rasterizer path rather than correctly splitting between Hardware Rasterizer and Software Rasterizer[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BUILD.MINDSEYE PATCH NOTES – PC ONLY[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]HIGHLIGHTS[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added a new “Player Content” Tile to the MindsEye Play Menu where all Builders published content will be immediately available to browse and play[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UGC Moderation flow from Pre-Moderation to Post-Moderation [/p][/*][*][p]Player made content will now be automatically accessible in the new “Player Content” Tile [/p][/*][*][p]A new Tile for “Curated Content” has been added, that will highlight player content picked by Build A Rocket Boy[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][p][b]Publishing UGC Content [/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a toggle to enable or disable Logic Nodes from being captured in the thumbnail capture of UGC Content [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Logic Nodes [/b][/p][list][*][p]Timer Nodes improved; you can update or refresh their value at any time through multiple other logic nodes, and can now be refreshed infinitely [/p][/*][*][p]Timer Logic Nodes now support decimal places up to .000 [/p][/*][*][p]Custom UI Nodes updated to always be set to “Node Active” = True, by default [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Attributes Menu, Catalogue & Versioning [/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor QoL & screen position improvements to the Creator HUD, Attributes Menu & Tools [/p][/*][*][p]Minor QoL improvements to naming, duplicated items, missing thumbnails or icons in the Assets Catalogue [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the search functionality in Assets Catalogue to take into account both object name and the tags[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning when the player reaches the maximum number of allowed versions when creating new versions [/p][/*][*][p]Added missing hotkeys to the Controls Panel for Inserting Path Points [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Featured Stamps Updates [/b][/p][list][*][p]Multiple fixes and QoL improvements to existing set of Featured Stamps [/p][/*][*][p]Added more Stamps to the Featured Stamps tile [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed EVERYWHERE vehicles from Build.MindsEye – those vehicles were made accessible unofficially, and we will bring them to MindsEye when they are ready[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the AI Spawner Spawn limits and Performance Scores of spawners were not correctly calculated[/p][/*][*][p]New Performance Score applied to AI Spawners as follows: [/p][list][*][p]AI Spawner – Performance Score: 10 / Max Quantity Allowed: 10 [/p][/*][*][p]Individual AI NPC - Performance Score: 6 / Max Quantity Allowed: 100[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p] Fixed an incorrect controls description for Build Collision Control List Keys; now correctly displayed as (B) instead of (P)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera behaviour in Build.MindsEye: your last position is now saved more frequently for a more reliable creation experience[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with erratic camera behaviour when using the Group Macro Node [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players were unable to like Stamps with long names[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from editing Stamp Descriptions that exceed the 220 character limit [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused vehicles to move very slowly, or not at all, when using Custom Speed on the Drive To Node [/p][/*][*][p]Grid snapping is now enabled on the XY Plane by default[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Destructible Assets not being selectable [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Filtering in the Assets Catalogue [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with the Vehicle Selection UI Node [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple issues with the Transform Variable Node and Advanced Transform Node parsing incorrect values into the Location and Scale Overrides[/p][/*][*][p]Stamp Attributes now display the correct Thumbnail based on the current Version selected [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with spawn-points and spawning in Build.MindsEye [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with the Physics Force Node causing objects to disappear [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Foliage Assets were not searchable in the Catalogue [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused when attempting to ungroup a group within a group [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by undoing creation and deletion of large Stamps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some deprecated assets being displayed in the library – which were discernible by having "DONOTUSE" in their name [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texture issues on a number of assets in the Build.MindsEye Catalogue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with missing Localisations for the Light Effects in Build.MindsEye[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We remain committed to refining MindsEye and enhancing the gameplay experience. Ongoing updates will continue to be shared.
[/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]The MindsEye Team[/p]

tags.feature: UI: Added the ability to Skip Cinematics story telling
Added a new “Player Content” Tile to the MindsEye Play Menu where all Builders published content will be immediately available to browse and play
Updated UGC Moderation flow from Pre-Moderation to Post-Moderation
Player created content will now be automatically accessible in the new “Player Content” Tile
A new Tile for “Curated Content” has been added, that will highlight player created content featured by our Studio

tags.bug: Trailer Tanks in Free Roam now explode when shot at
Improved traversal on A New Job and Loose Ends missions where player may get stuck in certain assets
Improved traversal on A New Job and Loose Ends missions where player may get stuck in certain assets
Resolved inconsistent dropdown menu behaviour in graphics settings, ensuring reliable input response

tags.feature: Added the ability to skip cinematics
Added Destruction SFX on Glass Bottle Props

tags.bug: Conditional dialogue now triggers with more natural pacing
The companion drone torch is now automatically enabled when entering or starting in dark areas
Exit/entry animations no longer play for driverless vehicles
Various Mission flow bug fixes
Fixed pixelated reflection in Rocket Transporter window
Fixed Industrial vent asset to help with performance
Resolved an issue where players transitioning from Meeting Marco Silva to Executive Paranoia could drive through objects and fall through the map
Fixed ambient animation glitches in Welcome to Redrock City
Fixed an issue where camera rotation was lost after cutscenes
Several lighting LOD pop issues fixed in cutscenes
Fixed a bug where burning vehicles wouldn’t transition to destroyed state
Fixed several traversal issues in world where the player may get stuck
Fixed an issue in The Ziggurat where a hole in wall allowed players to climb through and trap themselves
Fixed an issue in Oh Lily! where players could get stuck in Morrison's Silo without a way to get back out
Fixed collision on glass roof of Silva Factory
Fixed a number of Character Model issues in cutscenes that made them look deformed and stretched for a few frames
Resolved Silva’s teeth looking too bright on medium/ lower settings on PC
NPCs no longer freeze when interacting with certain objects
Weapon Wheel hover SFX is now triggered correctly, without delays

tags.feature: The character Red Sand Male 25 is now available for use in Build.MindsEye

tags.bug: Fixed a UI issue where backing out of a submenu in 'Build' caused the second-last selected tile to remain highlighted
Fixed a bug where the ‘effects’ tile would remain highlighted after returning to Build mode from Play mode
Fixed an issue where the placement header text overlapped UI elements in the asset settings menu when playing in French
Fixed a bug causing specific Korean characters to appear invisible in vehicle spawner labels
Fixed a localization issue where the French translation of “Total PI” overlapped with the performance impact number in the top toolbar
Replaced the incorrect icon used for the MindsEye menu button in Play/ Build with a proper menu icon
Fixed an issue where our Nanite render pipeline always used the Hardware Rasterizer path rather than correctly splitting between Hardware Rasterizer and Software Rasterizer

tags.feature: Added a new “Player Content” Tile to the MindsEye Play Menu where all Builders published content will be immediately available to browse and play
Updated UGC Moderation flow from Pre-Moderation to Post-Moderation
Player made content will now be automatically accessible in the new “Player Content” Tile
A new Tile for “Curated Content” has been added, that will highlight player content picked by Build A Rocket Boy
Added a toggle to enable or disable Logic Nodes from being captured in the thumbnail capture of UGC Content
Timer Nodes improved; you can update or refresh their value at any time through multiple other logic nodes, and can now be refreshed infinitely
Timer Logic Nodes now support decimal places up to .000
Custom UI Nodes updated to always be set to “Node Active” = True, by default
Minor QoL & screen position improvements to the Creator HUD, Attributes Menu & Tools
Minor QoL improvements to naming, duplicated items, missing thumbnails or icons in the Assets Catalogue
Updated the search functionality in Assets Catalogue to take into account both object name and the tags
Added a warning when the player reaches the maximum number of allowed versions when creating new versions
Added missing hotkeys to the Controls Panel for Inserting Path Points
Multiple fixes and QoL improvements to existing set of Featured Stamps
Added more Stamps to the Featured Stamps tile

tags.bug: Removed EVERYWHERE vehicles from Build.MindsEye – those vehicles were made accessible unofficially, and we will bring them to MindsEye when they are ready
Fixed an issue where the AI Spawner Spawn limits and Performance Scores of spawners were not correctly calculated
New Performance Score applied to AI Spawners as follows: AI Spawner – Performance Score: 10 / Max Quantity Allowed: 10 Individual AI NPC - Performance Score: 6 / Max Quantity Allowed: 100
Fixed an incorrect controls description for Build Collision Control List Keys; now correctly displayed as (B) instead of (P)
Improved camera behaviour in Build.MindsEye: your last position is now saved more frequently for a more reliable creation experience
Fixed an issue with erratic camera behaviour when using the Group Macro Node
Fixed an issue where players were unable to like Stamps with long names
Fixed an issue that prevented players from editing Stamp Descriptions that exceed the 220 character limit
Fixed an issue that caused vehicles to move very slowly, or not at all, when using Custom Speed on the Drive To Node
Grid snapping is now enabled on the XY Plane by default
Fixed an issue with Destructible Assets not being selectable
Fixed issues with Filtering in the Assets Catalogue
Fixed various issues with the Vehicle Selection UI Node
Fixed multiple issues with the Transform Variable Node and Advanced Transform Node parsing incorrect values into the Location and Scale Overrides
Stamp Attributes now display the correct Thumbnail based on the current Version selected
Fixed various issues with spawn-points and spawning in Build.MindsEye
Fixed various issues with the Physics Force Node causing objects to disappear
Fixed an issue where Foliage Assets were not searchable in the Catalogue
Fixed a crash caused when attempting to ungroup a group within a group
Fixed a crash caused by undoing creation and deletion of large Stamps
Fixed an issue with some deprecated assets being displayed in the library – which were discernible by having "DONOTUSE" in their name
Fixed texture issues on a number of assets in the Build.MindsEye Catalogue
Fixed an issue with missing Localisations for the Light Effects in Build.MindsEye

notes.title: Update 3 – PC
notes.content:
[p]Dear Community,   [/p][p][/p][p]Update 3 is [b]now live on PC[/b], following last week’s release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.   [/p][p]The PC update was briefly held back after our team identified a performance-impacting issue during final testing. That issue has been resolved, and the update is now available. We appreciate your patience as we ensured a stable release.   [/p][p]Update 3 [b]focuses on continued stability improvements and addressing community feedback[/b]. Please see a detailed outline below of the improvements included and, as always, please be aware that the list may contain some game and mission details that could be considered spoilers.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]RELEASE SCHEDULE & PLATFORM INFO: [/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Time: July 15th, 2025 - 14:00 BST / 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PST   [/p][/*][*][p]Platforms: PC   [/p][/*][*][p]Download size and version information:    [/p][list][*][p]Steam: 12.1 GB (Version #: 4885826)   [/p][/*][*][p]Epic Games Store: 12.1 GB (Version #: 4885826)  [/p][/*][*][p]Build A Rocket Boy Launcher: 12.1 GB (Version #: 4885826) [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]PATCH NOTES[/b]    [/p][p]Stability   [/p][list][*][p]Improved stability to reduce crashes, especially on extended play sessions   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI-related crashes that could occur during complex combat scenarios    [/p][/*][/list][p]Gameplay – Difficulty Rebalance   [/p][list][*][p]Increased AI accuracy across all difficulty levels for a greater challenge and more consistent encounters   Adjusted Medium difficulty by reducing damage filtering, resulting in slightly more challenging combat     [/p][/*][/list][p]Character Control   [/p][list][*][p]Improved cover entry behaviour, making transitions into cover feel smoother    [/p][/*][*][p]Improved stair locomotion, ensuring the player exits stair animations at the correct time and aligns properly with the steps   [/p][/*][*][p]Refined weapon handling during cover entry/exit transitions     [/p][/*][/list][p]Animation   [/p][list][*][p]Life scene animations have been improved, with smoother transitions     [/p][/*][/list][p]Vehicles   [/p][list][*][p]Improved vehicle behaviour on slopes, making stops feel more stable and predictable    [/p][/*][/list][p]AI   [/p][list][*][p]Fixed various bugs causing erratic AI behaviour    [/p][/*][/list][p]Environment   [/p][list][*][p]Improved martial law scenes with better behaviour and staging     [/p][/*][/list][p]Audio   [/p][list][*][p]Improved in-game vehicle audio for a more immersive soundscape   [/p][/*][*][p]Improved vehicle destruction audio, with a focus on window break sounds   [/p][/*][*][p]General audio data clean up and optimization   [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked pedestrian dialogue for more natural reactions     [/p][/*][/list][p]Cinematics   [/p][list][*][p]Addressed LOD issues in multiple scenes   [/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations to certain cinematics     [/p][/*][/list][p]Localization    [/p][list][*][p]Corrected various localization errors across multiple languages   [/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes   [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where graphics settings would reset after restarting the game. Settings now persist correctly    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a known issue where players could get stuck walking in a loop when interacting with specific objects         [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters stretching in certain cinematics and gameplay sequences    [/p][/*][*][p]Corrected texture issue with the Deluxe Edition vest    [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved flickering VFX in select areas    [/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes across menus and HUD elements    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual bugs in multiple environments    [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved abrupt weather changes during the final mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced ambient pedestrian movement and facial reactions    [/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several mission flow bugs that could block progression or disrupt scripted events    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where AI would exit vehicles and immediately die under certain conditions    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused AI to shoot while facing the wrong direction    [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted cover logic to prevent AI from clustering too closely    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed instances where AI would turn their backs on the player during combat    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where AI hit reactions wouldn’t trigger when shot    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies sticking out of vehicle roof windows weren’t affected by headshots[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Jacob could turn invisible when exiting a vehicle with the driver’s side blocked    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating occupants when driving Skycar in first-person view    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shooting the tires of an enemy jeep could launch it unexpectedly toward Jacob    [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a traversal issue where the player could get stuck behind unclimbable debris bags    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues affecting main campaign open-world encounters    [/p][/*][*][p]Updated third-person animations for Play.MindsEye content    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the drone UI marker would not correctly update when transitioning in or out of Play.MindsEye content during the campaign    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple issues with certain in-game screen objects appearing blank during cinematic sequences    Prevented players from exiting the Hades vehicle mid-flight, avoiding unintended behaviour    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dying outside the hangar could cause the player to respawn at an earlier checkpoint, resulting in lost progress in the “Clash of the Egos” mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jacob could become stuck inside the jeep if shot during the dismount animation in the “In Pursuit of the Orb” mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted fail conditions to be more forgiving and better reflect player behaviour in the “This Means War” mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted fail conditions during the CCTV section in the “Industrial Espionage” mission to prevent failure when the player's camera is aimed at Conti    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where failing to get to Silva’s home in time would cause the player to respawn at an incorrect checkpoint in the “Meeting Marco Silva” mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Claudia’s vehicle AI to reduce corner-cutting behaviour, resulting in a smoother driving path in “The Mole” mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the Digging minigame in “The Wrong Move” mission to provide earlier UI prompts and improve timing before input is required    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a known issue where the HUD might incorrectly display previous keybindings, when changing key bindings during a mission    [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where resolution and window mode in the settings menu did not match the applied settings after using ALT + Enter    [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BUILD MINDSEYE – PC ONLY [/b]

[b]Improvements [/b]  [/p][p]Asset Catalogue    [/p][list][*][p]Added a set of Rock & Foliage Objects to Build MindsEye’s Assets Catalogue   [/p][/*][*][p]Various Fixes & QoL Improvements to the set of Featured Stamps available in Build MindsEye’s Assets Catalogue   [/p][/*][*][p]Removed empty stamp sub-folders and updated thumbnails across key stamps   [/p][/*][*][p]Added missing Icons and fixed issues with some missing thumbnails   [/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the Mission Failure UI Node to undergo rework   [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance impact score of AI NPC instances    [/p][/*][/list][p]Editor UX & Camera   [/p][list][*][p]Increased Creator Camera location save frequency   [/p][/*][*][p]Build collision toolbar tooltip now displays correct Keybinding (B)   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor issues with Versioning in Build MindsEye around correctly detecting when changes have been made  [/p][/*][/list][p]Localization   [/p][list][*][p]Build.MindsEye Logger and Settings Dropdowns now support special characters; fixing an issue where some dropdown elements ended up showing as empty rows  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes [/b]  [/p][p]Creator Camera   [/p][list][*][p]Improved Camera behaviour when exiting ARCs and Camera’s position regeneration behaviour, fixing the problem when a builder was returning to an incorrect location when going back to Building mode    [/p][/*][/list][p]Logic Nodes   [/p][list][*][p]Fixed various issues with the Vehicle Selection UI Node   [/p][/*][*][p]Corrected ArcRC Spawn Vehicle Logic Node to properly interpret list of vehicles, enabling the logic node to spawn more vehicles   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various incorrect behaviours around the Physics Force and Gravity Nodes that would lead to detaching the player from Vehicles   [/p][/*][/list][p]UI   [/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect scrolling behaviour when hovering over various UI elements – The camera will no longer zoom forwards/backwards when scrolling while hovering over an Asset Catalogue   [/p][/*][*][p]Ungroup Button should now correctly display in the Attributes Menu    [/p][/*][/list][p]Catalogue & Asset Search   [/p][list][*][p]Particles folder now correctly indexed. Missing particle effects will now appear correctly in search [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted DLC weapon visibility to only appear when users own the related content    [/p][/*][/list][p]Player Respawn   [/p][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where player respawn triggers would not re-bind actor correctly   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with respawn time setting sometimes not having any effect    [/p][/*][/list][p]Stamps & Versioning   [/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues with Stamps incorrectly flagging unsaved pending changes   [/p][/*][*][p]Stamp Credits should now properly display the Author of the Stamp in the Stamps Landing page & Credits tile when inspecting a Stamp from the Public Stamps category    [/p][/*][/list][p]Stability   [/p][list][*][p]Patched more edge cases where UGC content might have contributed to the game client running out of memory  [/p][/*][/list][p]We appreciate the continued support from our community as we work to improve MindsEye and focus on enhancing the gameplay experience. We’ll continue to provide updates on a regular basis.     [/p][p]Thank you,    [/p][p][/p][p]MindsEye Team  [/p]

tags.bug: Improved stability to reduce crashes, especially on extended play sessions
Fixed AI-related crashes that could occur during complex combat scenarios

tags.balance_change: Increased AI accuracy across all difficulty levels for a greater challenge and more consistent encounters
Adjusted Medium difficulty by reducing damage filtering, resulting in slightly more challenging combat

tags.feature: Improved cover entry behaviour, making transitions into cover feel smoother
Improved stair locomotion, ensuring the player exits stair animations at the correct time and aligns properly with the steps
Refined weapon handling during cover entry/exit transitions

notes.title: Hotfix #2 Deployment
notes.content:
[p]Dear Community, [/p][p][/p][p]Hotfix #2 is now fully deployed on PC, PlayStation and Xbox. [/p][p][/p][p]Our priority remains listening to our community and addressing key concerns raised in your feedback, and deploying subsequent patches in a timely manner. [/p][p][/p][p]This hotfix is part of our ongoing efforts to refine the overall gameplay experience as we urgently identify and address game issues. Please make sure to update your game to the latest version to ensure the most recent fixes and improvements are applied.  [/p][p][/p][p]Below you’ll find detailed information, but please keep in mind that it contains some game and mission details that could be considered spoilers. [/p][p][/p][p][b]RELEASE SCHEDULE & PLATFORM INFO:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Time: June 18, 2025 - 10:00 BST / 11:00 CEST / 02:00 PT [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Platforms: PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Download size and version information: [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Steam: 5.4 GB (Version #: 18879510) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Epic Games Store: 5.4 GB (Version #: 1.0.4) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]PlayStation 5: 1.6 GB (Version #: 1.007.000) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Xbox Series X|S: 3.9 GB (Version #: 1.0.4.4) 
 [/p][/*][/list][p][b]PATCH NOTES - ALL PLATFORMS:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Continued performance improvements related to CPU, GPU, and memory use. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with AI vehicle collisions. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixes to some issues that caused the game to crash. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Resolved the situation where players could get a mission fail during the cinematic in the “Doxxed” mission. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Red Sky Car can no longer be destroyed during a cinematic. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Buggy springs contract correctly, and the tires spin during driving with Motion Blur off. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed an invisible collider that blocked progress in the “A New Companion” mission. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with vehicle de-spawning at the objective in the “A New Companion” mission. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where DPR and Delta.45 weapons were becoming attached to each other. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Addressed VFX sparks appearing too bright on damaged drones. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Rectified AI characters holding weapons at a 90-degree angle. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Corrected visuals of some male character models’ deformations when hit by vehicles. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]PC:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Build.MindsEye: Editor camera can now clip through the map and static props. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added an alert for AMD CPU users who have not updated to a version of Windows with branch prediction performance improvements. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ll continue releasing regular updates and working closely with the community to improve the experience. We are fully committed to doing everything possible to action your feedback. [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support. [/p][p][/p][p]MindsEye Team [/p]

notes.title: MindsEye's first hotfix plugs up its memory leak, and pledges to pop up PC hardware-related crash warnings
notes.content:
Good news, people who're still interested in giving MindsEye a go for reasons that don't involve gleefully watching as a poor NPC undergoes a sudden glitchy elongation. Developers Build A Rocket Boy have just pushed out the first in a series of updates designed to swat a bunch of the performance and crash-related issues that've plagued the game's launch.

If you were busy with other hobbies such as arctic exploration or hardcore spelunking earlier this week, the GTA/Cyberpunky Mindseye suffered a pretty nightmarish debut. The user reviews weren't totally negative right out of the gate, but it's fair to say it didn't land in the fashion ex-Rockstar bigwig Leslie Benzies' studio probably hoped.

Read more

tags.bug: MindsEye's first hotfix plugs up its memory leak

notes.title: MindsEye Hotfix Incoming
notes.content: [p]Dear Community,[/p][p] [/p][p]A heartfelt thank you to all our day-one players. We know the launch of MindsEye hasn’t been without its challenges for some of you.[/p][p] [/p][p]Right now, our top priority is game performance. We understand that the requirements are high and have limited the experience for many of you, and for this, we sincerely apologize.[/p][p] [/p][p]Improving performance across all devices is our immediate focus. A patch that begins our commitment to address this is scheduled for the end of this week on PC, which will also roll out to consoles as soon as possible.[/p][p] [/p][p]This upcoming hotfix will include:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Initial CPU and GPU performance improvements, along with memory optimizations[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced difficulty for the CPR mini-game[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A new setting to disable or modify Depth of Field[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A fix for an issue with missing controls for the MineHunter and Run Dungeon mini-games[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pop-up warnings for PCs that have Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling disabled, and PCs with CPUs that have potential crash issues[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]This will be the first in a series of updates aimed at enhancing your experience, and we’ll continue to share regular information.[/p][p] [/p][p]For our Steam players, we're excited to confirm that Build.MindsEye is now fully accessible. We can't wait to see what you create. We're also actively resolving any missing DLC entitlements - they'll be automatically added to your account as soon as possible.[/p][p] [/p][p]Important note: All players on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation will receive all the latest patches when connected to the internet. Please ensure your game is updated regularly to enjoy the benefits of the latest improvements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Please keep sharing your thoughts on your preferred platforms, including our support channels, Discord, Reddit, and through direct messages on social media. We read every single comment - yes, even the tough ones.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you again for your incredible support. This is just the start of a long-term vision to make MindsEye the best possible game for you.[/p][p] [/p][p]The MindsEye Team [/p]

notes.title: MindsEye launches to clips of ATVs glitchily spaghettifying a bloke named Seb, but a patch is on the way
notes.content:
Mindseye, the game from ex-Rockstar president Leslie Benzies-helmed studio Build a Rocket Boy, has arrived. Its launch has gone, er, a bit glitchily, currently landing the game at a mixed reception on Steam. That said, the studio have at least confirmed an update designed to improve Mindseye's performance is on the way.

If you're out of the loop, the sort of GTA-ish/Cyberpunk-ish game's road to release had been plenty weird prior to it breaking cover. Build a Rocket Boy co-CEO Mark Gerhard had seemingly suggested on the game's Discord server that he believed people were being paid to say negative things about Mindseye, and two other high-profile execs had departed the studio not long before release.

Read more
